title: Record of an initial configuration
statement: For any natural numbers $k$ and $s$, Boolean input word $x$, initial state $q_0$, and tag $\tau_0$, the record of the initial configuration consists of a state field containing $q_0$, the binary digits of $1$ with width determined by the length of $x$, then $k$ identical work-tape fields of length $2s+1$ whose cells are blank and whose head mark is set exactly at offset $s$, followed by the tag field containing $\tau_0$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a finite Boolean input word
